subject: Pilot KPI onboarding and gating — Avery Labs trial
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot KPI onboarding and gating — Avery Labs trial

Hi Julia — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed success matrix so we can align engineering, ops, and procurement before we spin up the trial environment. Attaching a lightweight metric sheet (avery-trial-metrics.xlsx) and our pilot playbook (redwood-pilot-playbook.pdf).

Proposed success criteria (please flag anything that doesn't map to your internal priorities):
- Latency: P95 generation latency under 120ms for typical 256-token prompts (measured at your GA region).
- Throughput: Sustained 100 concurrent requests/sec (avg request profile: 0.8 rps/user, 125 tokens/request).
- Cost: Effective cost <= $1.80 per 1k tokens at trial utilization (includes batching and KV cache).
- Quality: Intent-match accuracy >= 92% on your labeled test set; hallucination/incorrectness < 2% measured on 200 sampled responses.
- Reliability: 99.5% request success rate (2xx/3xx) during scheduled trial windows.

Operational notes / gating:
- Data flows: we'll push logs to a customer S3 bucket and stream anonymized eval metrics back to your analytics workspace.
- Rollout gating: If any metric misses by >10% after 3 business days of remediation, we'll pause the trial and schedule a focused RCA + remediation backlog.
- Owners: Redwood engineering (Marcus) for infra & latency tuning; Redwood solutions (Ben) for onboarding/runbook and daily cadence; Avery engineering (Julia) for workload generation and labeled eval set.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the criteria above (reply with edits) — by EOD Thu Jun 3.
2) We provision a smoke sandbox on Mon Jun 7 (2-day smoke window).
3) Full 2-week trial window starting Wed Jun 9 — instrumentation and daily 15-min syncs.

If that timeline looks tight for procurement, loop in procurement@averylabs.com and we can compress sign-off tasks.

Thanks — attaching files and a short one-pager in the playbook.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: avery-trial-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pilot-playbook.pdf (doc)
From: Julia Park <julia@averylabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@averylabs.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot KPI onboarding and gating — Avery Labs trial

Hi Naomi — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying points from our side:

- On latency: the 120ms p95 target is reasonable for our interactive demo flows, but for batch enrichment jobs we care more about throughput/cost; can we include a secondary throughput-latency profile for the 12k token batch path?
- On cost: procurement will need a ballpark for monthly run-rate at the expected pilot scale (we estimate ~15M tokens over 2 weeks). Can you provide an estimated cost envelope based on the proposed cost/token?
- On quality: we have an internal labeled set of ~1k examples for intent-match; would Redwood be ok running a stratified sample of 200/day during the trial window? We'll share access to the set.

Procurement note (cc): we need a basic SOW stub and expected FTE/engineer time commitments for onboarding. If Redwood has a standard trial SOW + rate card, please attach.

Happy to confirm the timeline once procurement is comfortable.

Thanks,
Julia
Senior Product Manager, Avery Labs
julia@averylabs.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@averylabs.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot KPI onboarding and gating — Avery Labs trial

Thanks Julia — quick responses and actions from our side: 

- Batch path: we can add a secondary profile for 12k-token batch runs. Proposal: target amortized latency end-to-end under 2.5s for batch jobs with throughput >= 10 batch jobs/min; cost objective remains focused on $/1k tokens with quantization profiles applied. I'll add that to the metrics sheet.
- Cost estimate: based on your 15M-token estimate and our target $1.80 / 1k tokens, expected pilot cost (compute + egress + infra) ~ $27,000. That is a ballpark; we can tighten after we see initial batching efficiency. I've added an 'estimated-run-rate' tab in the spreadsheet.
- Quality sampling: happy to run a 200/day stratified sample against your labeled set. We will only store evaluation hashes and anonymized metrics in your analytics bucket.
- SOW / trial support: attaching a brief trial SOW and a named engineer time estimate (redwood-pilot-playbook.pdf includes the SOW appendix). Typically 1 full-time Redwood engineer (5 days) for smoke + 0.5 FTE (engineering support) during the 2-week run.

Operational ask for Avery engineering: can you provide a small synthetic workload generator and a mapping of your top 10 intents by frequency? If you can share by Mon Jun 7, Marcus will provision infra and run an initial smoke.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@averylabs.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot KPI onboarding and gating — Avery Labs trial (finalize owners & next steps)

Appreciate the quick clarifications, Julia — summary and owners to lock this in: 

Confirmed success metrics (final):
- Latency: P95 < 120ms (interactive) — owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood infra)
- Throughput: 100 sustained req/s (interactive) — owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood infra)
- Batch: amortized E2E latency < 2.5s; throughput >= 10 batch jobs/min — owner: Marcus Lin
- Cost: target <= $1.80 / 1k tokens; estimated pilot spend ~ $27k — owner: Ben Carter (cost monitoring)
- Quality: intent-match >= 92% (stratified sampling 200/day) & hallucination < 2% — owner: Avery (Julia) for labeling, Redwood for evaluation scripts
- Reliability SLO: 99.5% success rate during trial windows — owner: Redwood ops (Marcus)

Milestones & timeline: 
- By Mon Jun 7: Avery provides workload generator + top-10 intent mapping + shared labeled set access.
- Mon Jun 7–Tue Jun 8: Redwood provisions smoke sandbox (Marcus).
- Wed Jun 9–Wed Jun 23: 14-day trial window; daily 15-min sync at 9:30 PT (standup channel TBD).
- If any gating metric fails >10% for 3 business days, automatic pause + RCA.

Documentation / procurement: Ben attached the SOW appendix in the playbook. Julia / procurement, please advise if you need a DocuSign link or a short license addendum for the trial.

Next immediate asks for Avery to unblock provisioning: workload generator + labeled set share + procurement go/no-go. If all green, we'll send a short kickoff invite for Mon Jun 7.

Thanks — I'll follow up Monday morning if I don't hear back.

Best,
Naomi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
